Shared and interacting upstream trigger factors in ferroptosis and pyroptosis

Shared and interacting upstream trigger factors in ferroptosis and pyroptosis. (A) ROS; (B) Ca2+; (C) Mitochondrial dysfunction; (D) cGAS‐ STING pathway. Green →, direct activation; grey ⇢, indirect activation; red ⊣, direct inhibition; red ‐ ‐ ‐ ⊣, indirect inhibition; green ↑, upregulation; red ↓, downregulation. Image created with BioRender
